text: Inscribe "hot" on Launch. Next, layout all the ovals as a ring.
Which hexagon is the nearest from Heron? Stick an indigo star named Iris. Link Krill to Fish and Algae.
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Attach the most recent ellipse to Card with a dotted line labeled "low priority". Summarize the diagram?
Running is a hexagon! Move it under Locked.
Park the oldest black star near Banner, then make the violet triangles way bigger!
Send the star behind, and connect it to Sprint2.
Nudge S3 by 100 pixel upwards. After that, write "Back" on it!
Axe Bug42. What's the lowest one? Clear the diagram!

We are planning the next sprint. What is the label of the new triangle? Make it a bit smaller. Are Heron and Squid linked? Attach Coral to Crab, and Crab to Shark. Next, detach Otter from Crab. Thanks.
Make a lime star left of the oldest rhombus "retry"; tie Pod1 and Queue.
Source is a tiny purple circle. Send it to the back!
I'm explaining this to my team later. Trade Lan and the lime hexagon. That's the main flow. Drag Nas 5 units left, and then rename it to Lumen! Is Ap2 small?
What is farthest to the latest navy ball? Is there anything around Tower? Rename the new brown ellipse to Prism.
Milk is a brown rhombus. Is there a navy star above Dough?
Put a small violet triangle, then duplicate the last one 3 times, and set the size of all the dots that are not red to minuscule! What is downstream from Grandma? Henceforth, stars are large and red.
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Earth should be underneath Moon. Which boxes are to the lower-right?
Drop the indigo diamonds, join Ground and Led, and axe all the lilac ones.
Take that back, then snip the arrow between Oven and Cream!
Place a wire from Jupiter to Sun. Set the size of all shapes to minuscule.
I'm sketching the family tree for grandma. List all arrows? Swap the positions of Pivot and Qb!
Get rid of blocks! Ugh, messy. What rules are there? Ceo is a red oval! Duplicate it 2 times.
Are there any golden hexagons? Build a ball! What color is the circle?
Banish the ellipses that are not yellow. Then exchange Switch1 and the black rect! How many lines does the hexagon have?
I'm explaining this to my team later. Banish Battery, then make the magenta hexagon a lime square.
Drag the last ball between Dough and Icing. After that, make 5 copies of the white rect.
Shrink the crimson triangles. Ugh, messy. Relocate Vcc and Sensor downwards, and after that wire Relay, Vcc and C2 each to the next one.
Hmm, let me think. Put a minuscule blue rectangle called Thistle. Also, make Thistle gray. After that, unlink Vcc from Capacitor.
Are there any orange hexagons? Arrange Ap2, Router and Dns in a circle.
Distribute everything evenly in a row. Almost done. Align them vertically. Rename the new rhombus to Tango. Perfect.
5 indigo balls! Duplicate the latest star, and throw a square named Quartz. That way it's easier to read. Shrink Card.
Drag the ball right side of Noah. Is Dad not white? Tidy up, then park the hexagon 60 pixels right. Then throw 4 blocks labeled "Cancel"!
Push the purple rects to the top left. Next, detach Submit from Begin! What's farthest to Review?
Any diamonds? Are Dave and Bob linked? What's the location of the earliest blue ellipse?

Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Line up the turquoise hexagons in a row! Is the earliest oval little? Shove the most recent triangle along the left edge. Place a white hexagon around the earliest rose star, and after that send the white hexagon to the back.
Do that again. Copy the earliest hexagon five times, and then link Shrine to the indigo star. Next, move all the orange stars to the left.
Make the rects a triangle. After that, arrange them as a grid, and draw an orange line from Idea to Risks.
New diamonds should be golden. Is the newest oval violet? Axe everything.
Is Squid alongside Otter? Build a huge yellow star on the right side called Xenon, and after that drag Crab 20 points down.
How many squares are there? Pop an oval named Kepler between Rb and Pivot. What does the dot connect to? Set the size of stars to medium!
Is the earliest oval right side of Parse? Turn that one black!
Hmm, let me think. Which is the largest? Make the hexagons that are not gold a yellow circle!
What size is Retry? New stars will be aqua.
I'm sketching the family tree for grandma. Attach Submit to Begin, Done and Retry with an arrow. Next, spawn a medium pink square that says "checkout".
Add a massive yellow triangle in the upper left. After that, change the squares that are not brown to huge! Attic is to the right of Closet.
What has the fewest connections? Line up the diamonds in a column. Ah, that's better. Is the latest rhombus between Uplink and Nas?
Are there any circles that are not teal? Place Mom and Olivia to the left of Liam!
We are planning the next sprint. Drop the stars. Next, turn the black hexagons huge. What's on the canvas?
Drop all triangles which are not orange, and then stick a black triangle. We need it for the meeting. Plonk a triangle. That's the main flow. Rename the newest one to Nova! Thanks.
My manager asked for this. How small is the indigo dot? New blocks must be navy. Nudge each triangle up. Thanks.
What does the blue hexagon say? How many edges do we have?
I'm sketching the family tree for grandma. Does Scope flow to Metrics? Make a blue rect between Vision and Users named Nook, and then ditch all the shapes! Nice.
Build a star. Rename the star to Hazel. Proxy is aqua. Move it over Modem. Next, copy it 3 times.
How large is the lime oval? Copy the latest ellipse 5 times! How many squares are there?
Make hexagons a small black square, and move the last navy ellipse on the right of Tackle. Then rename it to Beacon!
How many lines does rack3 have? Is Ap2 a rhombus? Send the same one to the back, and then join it to Nas.
Hmm, let me think. Tidy up the gray triangles. Neighbours of the diamond?
What shapes are indigo? Bring Risks to the front, and put a regular triangle called Vale! Summarise the drawing?

Hmm, let me think. Show me the connections? Drop all the stars that are not white! Neighbours of Ticket9? Which navy triangle is the farthest from Testing? Draw a purple triangle under Doing named Nectar.
Let me see. Tidy up! Ah, that's better. Count the links? Change all stars that are not cyan to a massive oval!
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Organise horizontally. Also, throw a pink ball at the center!

This is for tomorrow's review. Align Store and Retailer in a row, and caption all of the silver squares "Go". After that, reposition Customs and Warehouse underneath Store, then nudge the oldest oval 50 points to the left!
In future, all shapes are amber. Create an orange hexagon on the right of Navbar. After that, turn the new one blue.
Which shape is the leftmost? Which shapes can be reached from Sun? Label Jupiter as "Load data".
Make the indigo ones tiny. We need it for the meeting. Turn all the shapes amber. What is reachable from the navy rectangle?
Hook Resistor to C2 and Coil, and park the pink circle to the upper-left corner. It was getting crowded. Color it black. Sorry, long day. Drag it in the center of the page!
Discard the rules! What is reachable from the last triangle?
Hmm, let me think. Fuse is violet. Switch places of C2 and Motor. Is the graph circular?
Attach Lan, Modem and Dhcp each to the next, then place a tiny lime triangle. Ah, that's better. Make the lime triangle white. Almost done. Link that one to Ap2!
This is for tomorrow's review. Jupiter should be between Pluto and Venus. Duplicate it 3 times, and rename the earliest star to Bramble.
Rename the purple box to Cedar. Which one is nearest from Manager?
Duplicate the black box four times. Then attach C2, Battery and Ground in order with a line. Also, make the oval a lot smaller.
Is the earliest oval along the right edge? By default, everything is big! Pop a rhombus named Aster. Is Aster gold? Make Diode a bit bigger.
Disconnect Sprint2 from Todo. Which shapes are rose? Relocate Sprint2 and Epic alongside Testing! Perfect.
How many neighbours does Lan have? Does Firewall lead to the first rose triangle?
I'm sketching the family tree for grandma. Layout the blue dots in a circle. Then axe the oldest triangle. Also, raise the Flour!
I'm sketching the family tree for grandma. How big is Venus? Bring that one to the front. Also, hook it to Mercury! What's written on the oval?
I'm explaining this to my team later. How many stars do we have? Space all the blue dots horizontal evenly.

Reapply, and line up Loader, Validate and Deploy vertically. Disconnect Etl and Archive, and tuck the rose stars between Clean and Source. Then create 9 blue diamonds along the right edge. Almost done.
Make a lime hexagon. That's the main flow. Color the lime hexagon indigo, and then nudge it upwards.
Draw six medium squares in the upper-left corner. Then throw an orange triangle titled "TODO". Is the latest one white? Rename Led to Dune!

Transform all the black triangles into an ellipse, then pop a small rhombus between Rack3 and Wan labelled "urgent", and then wire Wan to Lan and Lan to Nas. Make the indigo stars a huge brown ellipse. We need it for the meeting. Where can I go from Switch1?
Spread all the orange stars out vertical. What does the green triangle say?
What's written on the new circle? Morph the rectangle into a triangle. Nice.
How many connections are there? Arrange Validate and Ingest as a grid. After that, sever the connection between Monitor and Clean.
Is Bob enormous? Park the hexagon between Sophia and Mom, and make it bigger!
Drag Rb underneath Pivot. I keep losing track of things. Replicate Pivot twice, and after that add a golden star! Thanks!
Tie Neptune, Sun and Saturn each to the next one! Is there a dot? Lay out Venus and Orbit as a grid. It was getting crowded. Make Saturn half the size.
I'm sketching the family tree for grandma. Bug42 is medium. Connect it to Sprint1. Nice.
Colour the objects that are not navy green. What is the size of Pod2? Is it cyan?
Hmm, let me think. Is Porch between Lounge and Kitchen? Is that one violet? Is there a path from Office to Closet? Space Bathroom and Office vertically! Thanks.

I'm sketching the family tree for grandma. Pantry is regular. Send the most recent rectangle backwards. Also, turn this one orange. After that, connect the lime triangle to Pantry with a turquoise arrow!
Connect Tackle to Center and Te, then revert that. Keeper is violet.
Connect Center and Qb. Sorry, long day. Take it back. How many links has the navy triangle got? Turn every diamond that is not gray golden.
Aunt just around Dave! Send the rhombus to the back. Sorry, long day. What color is it?
Nudge all of the navy balls on the right. Also, turn white squares regular.
Change the brown diamonds to a regular square! We need it for the meeting. Describe the canvas?
Is there anything between Reject and Retry? Separate Begin from Approve. That way it's easier to read. Send each hexagon to the back.
Turn boxes indigo. Next, tie Sprint1 to Backlog with a green arrow!
What is Depot? What rules are there? Nudge the first teal ellipse at the center.
Reposition Mine left! What is the farthest block from Cave? How small is the rhombus? Push all the lime rects above the circle. Thanks.
